paragraphs: TrackerAI — the SDR & AE account-tracking sales cockpit (formerly the SDR Outreach Coverage Dashboard), gated behind Google SSO (@spyne.ai only). Tracks outbound outreach by a DB-backed, admin-editable roster of SDRs & AEs from HubSpot — unique contacts/companies tapped, engagement depth, call-outcome + email breakdowns — across US/Eastern time windows (Today / Yesterday / This week / Last week / This month / Last month), plus:

within each GD → who was engaged (top contacts) → activity depth + last touch. An all-history engagement view over the same GD → rooftop → contact units that back the Accounts page and the coverage rollup.
BANTIC scores + drill-down, weekly coaching snapshots, Call Q column in the rep table.
features: GD Book Explorer (per rep): assigned Group-Dealership / Single units → rooftops engaged
Call quality (read-only from the call-scoring pipeline's Supabase): per-connected-call
Deals + demo funnel (V2): HubSpot deals (Auto Pipeline) segment every owned company into
Deal Health (V2): accounts with a live deal get a green/yellow/red health (stage + recency);
Deals & Accounts (V3) (/accounts): the Deal Funnel — a 3-lane stage funnel
